instruction.thesis: GOLD short via FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG: gold_gc_spot has moved from 4,661 (entry baseline) to 4,544, a -2.51% move in our favor, approaching the 5% target. More importantly, gold_hl_funding_ann has collapsed from 67.52% at entry to 5.48% at latest snapshot — a -91.88% decline in the funding signal. The original thesis was crowded longs at extreme funding; that crowding has now fully unwound. With funding normalized to near-baseline levels (5.48%), the carry advantage is gone and the mean-reversion thesis is complete. The position is at +2.54% P&L and the signal family evidence (both gold_gc_spot decline and gold_hl_funding_ann normalization) confirms thesis completion. Closing to lock in gains before potential reversal.
